answer: The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lagoon. What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a bullet-like short clauses, then a summary line register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors.
